category: usenet provider (Spanish-language, unlimited flats and volume plans)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial on the plans page read; four unlimited plans from USD 5 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: Over 3,000 days of files, stated on the vendor home page

egress.terms: Unlimited downloads on the four flat plans; speed tiers 10, 25, 50 and 100 mbps

tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: The cheapest flat is speed-capped at 10 mbps with 10 connections; a volume-based plan with no expiry date also exists on a separate page.

limits.value: 10 simultaneous connections on the 10 mbps plan, up to 100 on the 100 mbps plan

limits_note: Monthly: USD 5, 7, 9 and 12 for 10, 25, 50 and 100 mbps. Billed yearly: USD 4.17, 5.83, 7.50 and 10.00 a month (USD 50, 70, 90 and 120 a year).
binding_note: Downloads are unlimited; the speed tier and its connection count decide what a month retrieves.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the checkout was not opened, so the fields it asks for are behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Backbone and retention are not stated on the plans page read.
confidence_note: Prices, speeds and connection counts are from the vendor plans page read on 2026-11-03.
